Transport Modes

Sà lan chở hàng

A flat-bottomed vessel used for transporting heavy or bulk cargoes, often on inland waterways or for ship-to-shore operations, documented in waybills and port clearance documents.

Quick answer: A flat-bottomed vessel used for transporting heavy or bulk cargoes, often on inland waterways or for ship-to-shore operations, documented in waybills and port clearance documents.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Questions and answers

What is Sà lan chở hàng?

In this glossary, Sà lan chở hàng refers to: A flat-bottomed vessel used for transporting heavy or bulk cargoes, often on inland waterways or for ship-to-shore operations, documented in waybills and port clearance documents.

How is Sà lan chở hàng used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sà lan chở hàng vận chuyển máy móc tới cảng nội địa, được ghi trên vận đơn cho hải quan kiểm tra."

Sà lan chở hàng matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A flat-bottomed vessel used for transporting heavy or bulk cargoes, often on inland waterways or for ship-to-shore operations, documented in waybills and port clearance documents.

Operational example

The cargo barge transported machinery to the inland terminal, as recorded on the barge waybill for customs inspection.
